summary: Versioned JSON HTTP contract for graph writes, Datalog queries, schema observations, and point entity reads.
transport: POST or GET to the Poneglyph Worker URL, optionally under an application path prefix; consumers may also reach the Worker through a service binding.
framing: One JSON request and one JSON response per HTTP request; graph IDs appear in the URL path; POST bodies are bounded and parsed before storage dispatch.
version: Path prefix /v1; package version 0.1.0 is experimental without a stable compatibility promise.

messages.name: POST /v1/graphs/{graphId}/transactions
messages.summary: Submits one non-empty batch of typed facts; the server creates the transaction identity.

fields.name: graphId
fields.note: Lowercase graph identifier in the URL.

fields.name: facts
fields.note: Each fact has source, entity, field, tagged value, and optional retraction; client defaults retraction to false.

fields.name: clientRequestToken
fields.note: Optional non-empty graph-scoped retry key, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

returns.name: txId
returns.note: Server-minted identity, returned only after successful commit.

messages.name: POST /v1/graphs/{graphId}/query
messages.summary: Evaluates one Datalog source string over a consistent graph snapshot.

fields.name: graphId
fields.note: Lowercase graph identifier in the URL.

fields.name: query
fields.note: Bounded positive binary-relation Datalog subset with builtins.

returns.name: rows
returns.note: Complete result bag; duplicate rows are retained.

returns.name: snapshotSeq
returns.note: Maximum sequence in the returned subtree vector, not a graph-global clock.

messages.name: POST /v1/graphs/{graphId}/schema
messages.summary: Observes active fields and root fact-value tags at one leased subtree-vector snapshot.

fields.name: graphId
fields.note: Lowercase graph identifier in the URL.

fields.name: body
fields.note: Must be an empty JSON object.

returns.name: fields
returns.note: Observed inventory, not required fields or universal value constraints.

messages.name: GET /v1/graphs/{graphId}/entities?uri={entityUri}
messages.summary: Reads one current derived entity projection at a pinned owner snapshot.

fields.name: graphId
fields.note: Lowercase graph identifier in the URL.

fields.name: uri
fields.note: Absolute entity URI in the query string.

messages.name: HTTP error
messages.summary: Rejected or incomplete requests return an error object rather than a partial successful result.

fields.name: offset
fields.note: Parser location for invalid Datalog source.

returns.name: status
returns.note: 400 invalid input, 404 unknown path, 405 wrong method, 408 time budget, 413 exceeded budget, 423 contention, or 5xx unavailable/uncertain.

parsing.summary: The typed client parses graph IDs, facts, tokens, Datalog source, and server response shapes before treating them as trusted values.
The Worker parses the graph route and the coordinator parses bounded JSON bodies and action-specific request shapes before dispatch.
